records.text: Which one among the following was not an outcome of the fifth BRICS summit held in Durban in South Africa in March 2013?

options.A: Signing of two agreements on Extending Credit Facility in Local Currencies and BRICS Multilateral Letter of Credit Confirmation Facility
options.B: Proclamation of establishment of BRICS-led New Development Bank
options.C: Creation of a safety net through a Contingent Reserve Arrangement (CRA) among BRICS countries
options.D: Setting up of BRICS Business Council and BRICS Think Tank Council

records.text: Which one of the following statements is incorrect?

options.A: The Armed Forces Tribunal has the power to adjudicate disputes relating to conditions of service of persons subject to the Army Act, 1950.
options.B: Findings and sentences of court martial can be challenged before the Armed Forces Tribunal.
options.C: The Chairperson and members of the Armed Forces Tribunal shall be appointed only after consultation with the Chief Justice of India.
options.D: The Chairperson and members of the Armed Forces Tribunal can be removed only after consultation with the Chief Justice of India.

records.text: Who acts as the chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee?

options.A: The President of India in his capacity as the commander-in-chief

records.text: Which one of the following statements is correct?

options.A: The President cannot pardon a person sentenced by a Court Martial.
options.B: The supreme command of the defence forces of the Union vests in the President, but its exercise has to be regulated by law.
options.C: A person awarded rigorous imprisonment cannot be compelled to do hard work as this would amount to violation of Article 23 of the Constitution of India.
options.D: The Armed Forces Tribunal Act, 2007 excludes the powers of the High Courts under Article 226 of the Constitution of India in relation to service matters of persons in the armed forces.
